title: Archbishop Hoban vs. Walsh Jesuit — Football (2025–2026)
summary: The Knights erase a late deficit in the Holy War as Brayton Feister scores with 38 seconds remaining.
article_headline: Feister's Last-Minute Touchdown Lifts Hoban Past Walsh Jesuit, 19–14
article_dek: The Knights erase a late deficit in the Holy War as Brayton Feister scores with 38 seconds remaining.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Archbishop Hoban added another dramatic chapter to the Holy War on September 26, 2025, beating Walsh Jesuit 19–14 at Dowed Field. Hoban entered the final minutes trailing 14–13 before putting together a decisive drive.

Quarterback Nick Kinsey connected with Jackson Callaway for a big late gain, and Brayton Feister finished the possession with a short touchdown run with 38 seconds left. Feister totaled 125 yards and two touchdowns on 14 carries, according to High School On SI's game report.

Walsh had taken a 14–10 lead before Jeremy Hammel's fourth-quarter field goal cut the margin to one. The Warriors' last chance began deep in their own territory after a difficult kickoff return, and Hoban's defense preserved the lead. Jaiden Daniels recorded two interceptions, including a pivotal red-zone takeaway.

The game offered the kind of finish that defines a rivalry. Summit County Sports' gallery preserves a sideline look at the Knights and Warriors from the 2025 regular-season meeting.

article_highlights: Brayton Feister scored on a short run with 38 seconds left, turning a 14–13 Walsh lead into a 19–14 Hoban win.
Jackson Callaway made a crucial late reception from Nick Kinsey to advance the Knights to the Walsh 30 during the winning drive.
Feister rushed 14 times for 125 yards and two touchdowns; Jaiden Daniels intercepted two passes, including one in the red zone.
Walsh receiver Milan Parris caught a 29-yard touchdown from David Ternosky in the second quarter.
